title: Servicialo Operational Telemetry Event
description: Anonymized, bucketed event emitted by a Servicialo-compatible node to the protocol registry. Designed to enable market-level benchmarks (medians, percentiles, distributions) without exposing per-customer or per-provider data. All identifiers must be hashes or bucketed values — never raw IDs, names, emails, GPS, or exact prices.

protocol_version.description: Servicialo protocol version under which the event was emitted.

node_version.description: MCP server / implementation version that emitted the event.

event_type.description: One of the four supported operational events. Future events MUST go through an RFC.

region.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. No sub-national granularity is permitted — only country level — to avoid re-identification in low-volume segments.

occurred_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the underlying event. Day-bucketed in storage; sub-minute precision is irrelevant.

org_fingerprint.description: Opaque per-contributor identifier. SHA-256 of (org_slug + salt) computed by the emitter. Stable across events from the same node, but not reversible to org_slug. Used for k-anonymity (≥5 distinct fingerprints required before an aggregate is published).

payload.description: Event-specific bucketed fields. Schema depends on event_type — see oneOf below.

lead_time_bucket.description: Distance between booking creation and the service start time.

slot_hour_bucket.description: Hour-of-day bucket for the scheduled service in local time.

weekday.description: ISO weekday (1=Monday … 7=Sunday) of the scheduled service.

channel.description: Was the booking created by an AI agent or a human-facing UI.

outcome.description: Terminal outcome of the service lifecycle.

evidence_completeness.description: Whether the required evidence for the vertical was captured.

time_to_resolve_bucket.description: Time between dispute_opened and its resolution. Sent in a follow-up event when the dispute closes.

price_band.description: Price expressed in CLP-equivalent bands. Emitters convert via daily FX before bucketing. Bands are coarse enough that they cannot be inverted to an exact price for any specific transaction.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code of the original transaction (before normalization to CLP).
